title: Fitness-beats-truth theorem in evolutionary game theory

tellings.quote: In in fact, what we discovered is the probability is zero that any sensory system has ever been shaped to see any true feature of objective reality.

plain: According to a theorem from evolutionary game theory, the maths of how survival strategies compete, evolution rewards senses that help us survive, not senses that show reality as it is. The researcher Don Hoffman, who says he and his colleagues worked it out, building on John Maynard Smith and Darwin, tells Michels that "the probability is zero that any sensory system has ever been shaped to see any true feature of objective reality." If he is right, things we cannot perceive could be all around us.
